title: WhoisFreaks
description:
WhoisFreaks enriches Domain-Name observables with live WHOIS data from one API request: registrar, registration, update and expiry dates, name servers, DNSSEC status, domain status codes and registrant, administrative, technical, billing and abuse contacts.

Key features:

- Registrar turned into an Organization with a related-to relationship, carrying the IANA ID, website and abuse contact
- Name servers created as Domain-Name observables and linked to the domain
- Registrant organization and contact e-mail addresses (registrant, administrative, technical, billing, abuse) created and linked, skipping redacted placeholders
- Registration, update and expiry dates, DNSSEC and EPP status codes surfaced as labels and in a note with the full WHOIS report
- TLP checked before any data leaves OpenCTI
short_description: Enriches Domain-Name observables with live WHOIS data from WhoisFreaks: registrar, creation/expiry dates, name servers, domain status and registrant contacts.
